title: Primordial Paradox enemies file
description: Every enemy the battle director can start. Numbers here are the whole of the balance: no enemy stat lives in GML. Ranges mirror the constants in tools/check_data.py and tests/test_schemas.py compares the two.

attack.description: Damage range of a plain hit, inclusive. min above max is refused by the checker.

phase.description: One enemy phase, read by the battle director when current hp first satisfies hp * 100 <= hp_at_or_below * max_hp. The director adds pattern_id to the enemy's pattern pool, switches the TALK set to talk_set, plays line_id once at the crossing and swaps in the attack range, all from this row and never from a code branch on the enemy name. A raised attack must stay inside the enemy's spec 07 band, which the checker pins with PHASE_ATTACK_BAND.

hp_at_or_below.description: Percent of the enemy's max_hp, not absolute hp (spec 18 section 8 P3). Halving max_hp in data therefore keeps every band where it was. The checker refuses a row that is not strictly below the row above it in tools/check_data.py's PHASE_ROWS_MAX block.

pattern_id.description: Pattern id to add to the pool at this crossing. The enemy's own patterns list is the pool above the first threshold.

talk_set.description: Dialogue id that replaces talk_dialogue for the TALK command from this phase on, so the choice options shown in step 1 change with the phase. A dialogue id, never a talk card id.

talk_phase.description: The phase value of the talk card that applies from this crossing on, copied verbatim from a card's phase field in data/talk_cards.json (spec 16 section 10). The director matches the card on enemy id plus this string, and the cache key uses it as phase_id, so it never derives a phase name from an enemy name or from a dialogue id. Absent only while a phase has no card yet; tools/check_data.py refuses a card that no phase row names and a talk_phase that resolves to no card.

line_id.description: Dialogue id the director plays once when the crossing happens.

interrupt.description: The fight stops with no victory and no defeat and a scene takes over (spec 18 section 4). It fires on a REFUSED SPARE press, not on an hp crossing (spec 18 section 8 A18-1): an hp trigger above 9 percent of a 120 hp bar makes the boss unkillable with the biggest legal blow. Do not copy this block onto an encounter row; the enemy row owns it (refusal 10).

on.description: The only trigger in the demo, and the set is closed.

hp_at_or_below.description: Percent of max_hp, the gate on the SPARE request rather than a crossing. The checker refuses a threshold at or below the enemy's spare_hp_percent, because there SPARE is accepted and the story exit can never fire (spec 18 section 7 refusal 8).

unless_flag.description: Optional flag name from data/flags.json. The trigger is disabled while this flag is true, so a story beat that has already happened does not repeat.

scene.description: The scene the fight hands over to. Either one scene id, or an object with all four route keys so the scene may differ per route (spec 18 section 8 A18-4). A partial object is an error, never a default.

reward.description: What the fight gives. kind item and power name an id in those tables; health gives a flat amount and names nothing.

sprite.description: Sprite resource name. Placeholder until the 8 bit look pass.

element.description: Free form damage element tag, sea, fire, veil and so on.

route_kind.description: Boss fights count toward the route ledger differently. Defaults to regular when absent.

patterns.description: The bullet patterns this enemy may use, by id in data/patterns/all.json.

talk_dialogue.description: Dialogue id played by the TALK command.

trust_to_spare.description: TALK count that reaches the spare threshold.

spare_hp_percent.description: HP percentage at or below which SPARE is allowed.

phases.description: Optional ordered phase crossings. The director applies the FIRST phase whose hp_at_or_below the enemy's current hp has reached, so thresholds must descend and each must be below max_hp; tools/check_data.py enforces the order and the band.
